proofType: Frontend rejection of captured unsafe upstream/cached shopping rows. All API calls and images are intercepted; no live supplier, local-shop, account or image-generation proof.
fixtureNote: Captured product identities, prices, pack quantities and eligibility are retained in negative fixtures, including actual reviewable-but-not-eligible pet-food rows. Timestamps are refreshed only to avoid testing staleness, and every unsafe candidate is deliberately injected as chosen. Rice, valid manual-brand review and positive name controls are synthetic, explicitly labelled fixtures; positive controls deliberately enable eligibility.
